title: Checking coffee farmers' climate reports in Colombia
who: Daniel (fictional), YSE doctoral student on the project.
shows: Farmer reports are the project's own data

program: Community sensing of climate impacts (Yale Planetary Solutions grant)
based_on: A 2025 Yale Planetary Solutions project collects smallholder farmers' climate reports by SMS game and field-tested it in Cauca, Colombia

steps.message: Coffee farmers in Cauca, Colombia, report drought and heavy-rain losses by SMS. Which satellite and climate records can check their reports from the 2023-2024 El Nino, municipality by municipality?
